title: SearchInput
wrapsNative: searchable(text:placement:prompt:) in a NavigationStack, with onSubmit(of: .search), searchSuggestions and searchScopes
summary: A search box for filtering a list or querying a server is the system search field, added to the navigation bar with searchable. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: To search or filter the content of a screen that has a navigation bar. The system supplies the magnifier, the clear button, the Cancel button, the keyboard's Search key and the hide-on-scroll behaviour.
whenNotToUse: Not for a search box in the middle of a screen, inside a form or a sheet without a navigation bar: use MonarchTextField there. Not for choosing one value from a list (use a Picker).
api: func searchable(text: Binding<String>, placement: SearchFieldPlacement = .automatic, prompt: String) -> some View
func onSubmit(of triggers: SubmitTriggers, _ action: @escaping () -> Void) -> some View
func searchSuggestions<S: View>(_ suggestions: () -> S) -> some View
func searchScopes<V: Hashable, S: View>(_ scope: Binding<V>, scopes: () -> S) -> some View

states.name: active
states.description: The field has focus, the keyboard is open and the system shows a Cancel button. isSearching in the environment is true.

states.name: with text
states.description: The system shows a clear button at the trailing edge.

states.name: loading
states.description: The field has no pending state. Show a ProgressView in the results while a server query runs.

appearance: The system draws the field in every theme. The theme's tint colours the cursor and the Cancel button; Monarch colours and type are not applied to the field.
platformNotes: The web SearchInput draws an icon, a clear button, a pending spinner and a shortcut hint, and debounces onSearch. On iOS the icon, clear button and Cancel are the system's. The web's debounce is task(id: query) with a short sleep, as in the second example; pending is a ProgressView in the results; the shortcut hint is not shown. The web's sizes do not apply. MonarchTextField has no leading icon or clear button yet, so an inline search box outside a navigation bar is a plain labelled field. Android styles the Material 3 SearchBar as MonarchSearchBar; iOS adopts the system field.
accessibility: System behaviour: the field has the search field trait, the prompt as its placeholder and a labelled clear button.
System behaviour: the keyboard's return key is Search, and onSubmit(of: .search) runs on it.
Announce the number of results after a query with AccessibilityNotification.Announcement, since the list changes without focus moving.
edgeCases: searchable has no effect without a NavigationStack or NavigationSplitView around the view.
placement .navigationBarDrawer(displayMode: .always) keeps the field visible; the default hides it until the list is pulled down.
Filtering on every keystroke is fine for local data; debounce a server query.
An empty result needs its own message: ContentUnavailableView.search.
